Low contrast ground lead: Elevated dark #1e293b power supply negative wire stroke to #64748b against the #090d16 canvas floor for high visibility.
Canvas typography legibility (Q25): Upgraded sub-9px text (7px and 8px) on electrometer buttons, knob indicators, and probe labels to 9px.
Observation table record button (btnRecord) omitted the Dry Sample Mass (Ws) column, causing all subsequent mass readings (W1, W2, W3, W4, WL, G) to misalign across the 8 table headers.
Action buttons btn_evacuate_air ('Apply Vacuum & Agitate to Evacuate Entrapped Air') and btn_tare_balance ('Zero / Tare Digital Balance') were defined in HTML but unwired in canvas_js.
Stepper increment/decrement buttons (.stepper-btn-up, .stepper-btn-down) were unwired in canvas_js.
Experiment mode selector (Water for soil solids vs. Kerosene for cement) was unwired to update displacing fluid and mineral gravity parameters.

Observation table column count mismatch: btnRecord inserted 11 cells (including R, L, E, and eta) into tbody, whereas observation_thead_html has only 7 columns (Firing Angle, Peak Voltage, V0, I0, Vrms, Pdc, RF), causing severe table misalignment.
Unwired stepper controls: Stepper buttons (.stepper-btn-up and .stepper-btn-down) and input listeners were not bound to click or change handlers, making steppers non-functional.
Unwired action buttons: btn_toggle_pulses (Trigger Gate Firing Pulses) and btn_inversion_preset (Set Inversion Mode α = 120°) were defined in HTML but had no click event handlers wired in canvas_js.
Readout DOM text replacement: updateTelemetry directly overwrote valEl.textContent, stripping the nested MathML unit elements from live readout spans.
